description: Colorizes black-and-white photos, with face enhancement on by default; already-colour photos are not recoloured and not charged (the result is still a JPEG, long edge ≤1024 px). Takes about 8 s on a warm GPU (beta — no SLA). Returns the processed image in an image content block as a JPEG whose long edge is at most 1024 px — a larger input comes back scaled down. Free tiers: 10 credits/day per anonymous IP, 30/day with a key; this tool costs 1 credits (1 credit = $0.01) beyond that. The quota left is echoed in the result text. A job that outruns the wait comes back as a status_url to poll.

face.description: On by default: restores faces after colorizing without reshaping them; up to 8 faces, small faces get smoother. Send false to skip

image_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). A data-URI prefix (RFC 2397) is accepted. Provide either this or image_url.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to process (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). Use a hostname, not an IP literal.

wait.description: Seconds to block waiting for the result (1–25). Past 25 the honest answer is a 202 + status_url you poll yourself, because MCP hosts time tool calls out.

name: colorize

account.description: Account page: usage, API keys, buying credits.

bytes.description: Size of the returned image in bytes.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. quota_exhausted, unauthorized, rate_limited.

cost.description: Credits this call needed (1 credit = $0.01; upscale 2, everything else 1).

hint.description: What the caller should do next, in plain words (quota errors).

http_status.description: The HTTP status the REST layer answered with.

job_id.description: Job id, also sent as the x-job-id response header.

limit.description: The daily allowance that was reached.

login.description: Login URL — only when an anonymous caller ran out of quota.

price_per_image_cny.description: The same price in CNY, rounded.

price_per_image_usd.description: Prepaid price per image past the free allowance.

quota_kind.description: Which ledger ran out: anon, key, or web.

register.description: Sign-up URL — only when an anonymous caller ran out of quota.

remaining_today.description: Images left on this caller's daily quota.

status_url.description: Only when the job is still running (HTTP 202).

used.description: Images already used today on that ledger.
